### Health Analytics with R · Module 07: Geospatial & Spatial Epidemiology
***
**This capstone integrates NB-01 through NB-07 into a comprehensive spatial health inequity analysis.**

**Research Question:** Where are counties with high CVD mortality, high pollution burden, AND poor healthcare access simultaneously concentrated — and how does this geographic intersection relate to poverty?

**Pipeline stages:**
1. Data assembly: choropleth mapping of all key variables
2. Spatial autocorrelation: Moran's I + LISA for CVD mortality and poverty
3. Spatial cluster detection: scan statistic for CVD hot spots
4. Spatial regression: OLS → spatial lag model comparing estimates
5. Empirical Bayes disease mapping: smoothed SMR surface
6. Environmental justice: pollution × race/income analysis
7. Access mapping: 2SFCA + HPSA identification
8. Compound disadvantage index: counties with multiple burdens
9. Publication-quality 8-panel figure (300 dpi) + methods narrative

**Estimated time:** 4 hours | **Level:** Advanced

## 0. Setup & Synthetic County Dataset

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(spatialreg)
library(patchwork)

set.seed(42)
out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod07")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)

SEED <- 42
NROW <- 10; NCOL <- 20; N <- NROW * NCOL
row_idx <- rep(seq_len(NROW), each = NCOL)
col_idx <- rep(seq_len(NCOL), times = NROW)

spatial_smooth <- function(v, s = 2) {
  g <- matrix(0, NROW, NCOL)
  for (i in seq_along(v)) g[row_idx[i], col_idx[i]] <- v[i]
  k <- ceiling(3 * s)
  xs <- (-k):k
  kern <- outer(dnorm(xs, sd = s), dnorm(xs, sd = s)); kern <- kern / sum(kern)
  pad <- k
  gp <- matrix(0, NROW + 2 * pad, NCOL + 2 * pad)
  gp[(pad + 1):(pad + NROW), (pad + 1):(pad + NCOL)] <- g
  out <- matrix(0, NROW, NCOL)
  for (r in seq_len(NROW)) for (c in seq_len(NCOL)) {
    out[r, c] <- sum(gp[r:(r + 2 * k), c:(c + 2 * k)] * kern)
  }
  mapply(function(r, c) out[r, c], row_idx, col_idx)
}

lon <- -120 + (col_idx - 1) * 2.5 + rnorm(N, 0, 0.3)
lat <- 28 + (row_idx - 1) * 2.0 + rnorm(N, 0, 0.2)
pct_poverty   <- 10 + 8 * rbeta(N, 2, 5) + 3 * sin(lon / 20)
pct_uninsured <- 8 + 6 * rbeta(N, 2, 4) + 0.3 * pct_poverty
pct_minority  <- pmin(pmax(20 + 15 * rbeta(N, 2, 3), 0), 100)
pct_rural     <- pmin(pmax(30 + 40 * rbeta(N, 3, 3), 0), 100)
population    <- as.integer(rlnorm(N, 10.5, 1.0))
pm25_base     <- 8 + 4 * (lon - min(lon)) / (max(lon) - min(lon))
pm25 <- pmin(pmax(pm25_base + spatial_smooth(rgamma(N, 1, 1), 1.5) + rnorm(N, 0, 1), 3), 28)
spatial_risk <- spatial_smooth(rnorm(N), 2.5)
cluster1 <- (lon > -105) & (lon < -95) & (lat > 30) & (lat < 36)
cluster2 <- (lon > -85) & (lon < -75) & (lat > 38) & (lat < 44)
base_cvd <- (180 + 1.2 * pct_poverty + 0.8 * pct_uninsured + 0.5 * pm25 +
               12 * spatial_risk + rnorm(N, 0, 10))
cvd_rate <- base_cvd
cvd_rate[cluster1] <- cvd_rate[cluster1] + 35
cvd_rate[cluster2] <- cvd_rate[cluster2] + 25
expected <- (cvd_rate / 100000) * population * 5
observed <- rpois(N, expected)
smr <- observed / pmax(expected, 1)

set.seed(5)
N_H <- 40
hlon <- runif(N_H, min(lon), max(lon))
hlat <- runif(N_H, min(lat), max(lat))
hbeds <- sample(50:600, N_H, replace = TRUE)
hosp <- st_as_sf(tibble(lon = hlon, lat = hlat, beds = hbeds),
                 coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

df <- tibble(
  county_id = sprintf("C%03d", seq_len(N) - 1),
  lon, lat, row = row_idx, col = col_idx,
  pct_poverty, pct_uninsured, pct_minority, pct_rural, pm25, population,
  cvd_rate, observed, expected, smr, cluster1, cluster2
)
geoms <- Map(function(lo, la) {
  st_polygon(list(matrix(
    c(lo - 1.25, la - 1, lo + 1.25, la - 1, lo + 1.25, la + 1,
      lo - 1.25, la + 1, lo - 1.25, la - 1), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE
  )))
}, df$lon, df$lat)
gdf <- st_sf(df, geometry = st_sfc(geoms, crs = 4326))
cat(sprintf("N=%d counties | CVD=%.1f/100k | PM2.5=%.1f µg/m³\n",
            N, mean(cvd_rate), mean(pm25)))
```

## 1. Build Spatial Weights

```{r}
nb <- vector("list", N)
for (i in seq_len(N)) {
  nbrs <- which(pmax(abs(df$row - df$row[i]), abs(df$col - df$col[i])) <= 1)
  nb[[i]] <- setdiff(nbrs, i)
}
class(nb) <- "nb"
attr(nb, "region.id") <- as.character(seq_len(N))
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Spatial weights: N=%dx%d | Mean neighbours: %.1f\n",
            N, N, mean(card(nb))))
```

## 2. Global & Local Moran's I

```{r}
I_cvd  <- moran.test(df$cvd_rate, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
I_pov  <- moran.test(df$pct_poverty, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
I_pm25 <- moran.test(df$pm25, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
mc_cvd <- moran.mc(df$cvd_rate, lw, nsim = 499, zero.policy = TRUE)
cat("Global Moran's I:\n")
cat(sprintf("  CVD rate : %.4f (p=%.4f)\n",
            unname(I_cvd$estimate["Moran I statistic"]), mc_cvd$p.value))
cat(sprintf("  Poverty  : %.4f (p=%.4f)\n",
            unname(I_pov$estimate["Moran I statistic"]),
            moran.mc(df$pct_poverty, lw, nsim = 499)$p.value))
cat(sprintf("  PM2.5    : %.4f (p=%.4f)\n",
            unname(I_pm25$estimate["Moran I statistic"]),
            moran.mc(df$pm25, lw, nsim = 499)$p.value))

lisa <- localmoran(df$cvd_rate, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
z <- as.numeric(scale(df$cvd_rate))
zlag <- lag.listw(lw, z, zero.policy = TRUE)
quad <- ifelse(z > 0 & zlag > 0, "HH", ifelse(z < 0 & zlag < 0, "LL", "Other"))
gdf$lisa_cvd <- ifelse(lisa[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"] < 0.05, quad, "NS")
gdf$lisa_p_cvd <- lisa[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"]
cat(sprintf("\nLISA CVD: HH=%d LL=%d NS=%d\n",
            sum(gdf$lisa_cvd == "HH"), sum(gdf$lisa_cvd == "LL"),
            sum(gdf$lisa_cvd == "NS")))
I_cvd_val <- unname(I_cvd$estimate["Moran I statistic"])
p_cvd_val <- mc_cvd$p.value
```

## 3. Spatial Cluster Detection (Scan Statistic)

```{r}
scan_stat <- function(df_in, max_frac = 0.4, n_perm = 99, seed = 42) {
  coords <- cbind(df_in$lon, df_in$lat)
  O_tot <- sum(df_in$observed); E_tot <- sum(df_in$expected)
  n <- nrow(df_in); max_pop <- sum(df_in$population) * max_frac
  dmat <- as.matrix(dist(coords))
  llr <- function(Oz, Ez) {
    if (Oz <= 0 || Ez <= 0 || Oz <= Ez) return(0)
    Oo <- O_tot - Oz; Eo <- E_tot - Ez
    if (Oo <= 0 || Eo <= 0 || Oo <= Eo) return(0)
    max(0, Oz * log(Oz / Ez) + Oo * log(Oo / Eo))
  }
  best_llr <- 0; best_c <- 1; best_r <- 0; best_in <- integer(0)
  for (ci in seq_len(n)) {
    ord <- order(dmat[ci, ])
    Oz <- 0; Ez <- 0; popz <- 0
    for (k in 2:n) {
      j <- ord[k]; popz <- popz + df_in$population[j]
      if (popz > max_pop) break
      Oz <- Oz + df_in$observed[j]; Ez <- Ez + df_in$expected[j]
      l <- llr(Oz, Ez)
      if (l > best_llr) {
        best_llr <- l; best_c <- ci; best_r <- dmat[ci, j]; best_in <- ord[2:k]
      }
    }
  }
  set.seed(seed)
  mc <- numeric(n_perm)
  E_arr <- df_in$expected
  for (b in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    Op <- as.numeric(rmultinom(1, O_tot, E_arr / E_tot)); bl <- 0
    for (ci in seq_len(n)) {
      ord <- order(dmat[ci, ]); Oz <- 0; Ez <- 0; popz <- 0
      for (k in 2:n) {
        j <- ord[k]; popz <- popz + df_in$population[j]
        if (popz > max_pop) break
        Oz <- Oz + Op[j]; Ez <- Ez + E_arr[j]
        l <- llr(Oz, Ez); if (l > bl) bl <- l
      }
    }
    mc[b] <- bl
  }
  list(best_llr = best_llr, best_c = best_c, best_r = best_r,
       best_in = best_in, p = mean(mc >= best_llr))
}

cat("Running scan statistic...\n")
sc <- scan_stat(df)
gdf$in_scan_cluster <- seq_len(N) %in% sc$best_in
cat(sprintf("Primary cluster: LLR=%.2f p=%.3f n=%d counties\n",
            sc$best_llr, sc$p, length(sc$best_in)))
```

## 4. Spatial Regression

```{r}
ols <- lm(cvd_rate ~ pct_poverty + pct_uninsured + pm25, data = df)
ols_pov <- coef(ols)["pct_poverty"]
I_resid <- moran.test(residuals(ols), lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("OLS: poverty β=%.3f | Moran I(resid)=%.4f (p=%.4f)\n",
            ols_pov, unname(I_resid$estimate["Moran I statistic"]), I_resid$p.value))

slm <- lagsarlm(cvd_rate ~ pct_poverty + pct_uninsured + pm25,
                data = df, listw = lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
slm_pov <- coef(slm)["pct_poverty"]
cat(sprintf("SLM: rho=%.3f | poverty β=%.3f | bias vs OLS: %+.3f\n",
            slm$rho, slm_pov, slm_pov - ols_pov))
cat("True poverty coefficient: 1.20\n")
```

## 5. Empirical Bayes Disease Mapping

```{r}
smr_mean <- mean(df$smr); smr_var <- var(df$smr)
extra_var <- max(smr_var - smr_mean / mean(df$expected), 0.01)
alpha_hat <- smr_mean^2 / extra_var; beta_hat <- smr_mean / extra_var
gdf$smr_eb <- (df$observed + alpha_hat) / (df$expected + beta_hat)
cat(sprintf("EB smoothing: raw SMR SD=%.4f -> smoothed SD=%.4f\n",
            sd(df$smr), sd(gdf$smr_eb)))
cat(sprintf("(variance reduction: %.1f%%)\n",
            (1 - sd(gdf$smr_eb) / sd(df$smr)) * 100))
```

## 6. Access Metrics & Compound Disadvantage Index

```{r}
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
centroids <- st_centroid(gdf)
dist_m <- st_distance(centroids, hosp)
dist_mat <- as.numeric(dist_m)
dim(dist_mat) <- dim(dist_m)
if (max(dist_mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 50) dist_mat <- dist_mat / 111000
CATCH <- 4.5
R_j <- numeric(N_H)
for (j in seq_len(N_H)) {
  in_z <- dist_mat[, j] <= CATCH
  denom <- sum(df$population[in_z] / (dist_mat[in_z, j] + 0.1)^2)
  R_j[j] <- if (denom > 0) hbeds[j] / denom else 0
}
A_i <- numeric(N)
for (i in seq_len(N)) {
  in_z <- dist_mat[i, ] <= CATCH
  if (any(in_z)) {
    w <- 1 / (dist_mat[i, in_z] + 0.1)^2
    A_i[i] <- sum(R_j[in_z] * w)
  }
}
gdf$access_2sfca <- A_i

quintile_score <- function(v, higher_is_worse = TRUE) {
  q <- as.numeric(cut(v, quantile(v, 0:5 / 5), include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE))
  if (higher_is_worse) q else 6 - q
}
gdf$cdi <- (quintile_score(gdf$cvd_rate) + quintile_score(gdf$pct_poverty) +
              quintile_score(gdf$pm25) + quintile_score(gdf$pct_uninsured) +
              quintile_score(gdf$access_2sfca, higher_is_worse = FALSE)) / 5
gdf$cdi_cat <- cut(gdf$cdi, breaks = c(0, 2, 3, 4, 5.1),
                   labels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High", "Very High"))

cat("Compound Disadvantage Index:\n")
for (lab in c("Low", "Moderate", "High", "Very High")) {
  n_c <- sum(gdf$cdi_cat == lab, na.rm = TRUE)
  pop_c <- sum(gdf$population[gdf$cdi_cat == lab], na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("  %-12s: %3d counties | %s residents (%.1f%%)\n",
              lab, n_c, format(pop_c, big.mark = ","),
              pop_c / sum(gdf$population) * 100))
}
```

```{r}
CLUSTER_COLORS <- c(HH = "#DC2626", LL = "#2563EB", Other = "#B3CDE3", NS = "#E0E0E0")
CDI_COLORS <- c(Low = "#2563EB", Moderate = "#B3CDE3", High = "#FEC44F", `Very High` = "#DC2626")

p_a <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = cvd_rate), colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdYlGn", direction = -1, name = "Rate/100k") +

p_b <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = smr_eb), colour = NA) +

                       oob = scales::squish, name = "EB-SMR") +

p_c <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = lisa_cvd), colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CLUSTER_COLORS) +
  labs(title = "C  LISA Clusters", fill = NULL) + theme(axis.title = element_blank())

circ <- {
  sf_use_s2(FALSE)
  st_buffer(st_sfc(st_point(c(df$lon[sc$best_c], df$lat[sc$best_c])), crs = 4326),
            dist = sc$best_r)
}
p_d <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = in_scan_cluster), colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = circ, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#DC2626", "FALSE" = "#E0E0E0"), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = sprintf("D  Scan Statistic (LLR=%.1f,p=%.3f)", sc$best_llr, sc$p)) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank())

p_e <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = pm25), colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "YlOrBr", direction = 1, name = "µg/m³") +
  labs(title = "E  PM2.5 Exposure") + theme(axis.title = element_blank())

p_f <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = access_2sfca), colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = hosp, shape = 3, size = 1.5, colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdYlGn", direction = 1, name = "2SFCA") +
  labs(title = "F  2SFCA Healthcare Access") + theme(axis.title = element_blank())

p_g <- ggplot(gdf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = cdi_cat), colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = dplyr::filter(gdf, cluster1 | cluster2), fill = NA,
          colour = "gold", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CDI_COLORS) +
  labs(title = "G  Compound Disadvantage Index (CDI)", fill = NULL) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank())

reg_df <- tibble(method = c("OLS", "Spatial Lag"), coef = c(ols_pov, slm_pov))
p_h <- ggplot(reg_df, aes(method, coef, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, colour = "white") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.20, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", coef)), vjust = -0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(OLS = "#2563EB", `Spatial Lag` = "#DC2626"), guide = "none") +
  labs(y = "Poverty coefficient (β)", title = "H  Spatial Regression: Poverty→CVD", x = NULL)

z_cvd <- as.numeric(scale(df$cvd_rate))
Wz_cvd <- lag.listw(lw, z_cvd, zero.policy = TRUE)
p_i <- ggplot(tibble(z = z_cvd, Wz = Wz_cvd, rate = df$cvd_rate), aes(z, Wz, colour = rate)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_distiller(palette = "RdYlGn", direction = -1, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "z(CVD rate)", y = "W*z (spatial lag)",
    title = sprintf("I  Moran Scatterplot (I=%.3f, p=%.3f)", I_cvd_val, p_cvd_val)
  )

p_atlas <- (p_a | p_b | p_c | p_d) /
  (p_e | p_f | p_g) /
  (p_h | p_i) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Spatial Health Inequity Atlas — CVD Mortality, Pollution & Access (N=200 Counties)"
  )
print(p_atlas)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "capstone_spatial_atlas.png"), p_atlas,
       width = 22, height = 16, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: capstone_spatial_atlas.png (300 dpi)\n")
```

## 8. Methods Narrative Template

> **Spatial Epidemiology Methods**
>
> We conducted a county-level (N=200) spatial analysis of CVD mortality, environmental exposures, and healthcare access. Age-adjusted CVD mortality rates were empirical Bayes (EB) smoothed using a Gamma-Poisson conjugate model to stabilise estimates in low-population counties.
>
> Spatial autocorrelation was assessed using Global Moran's I with queen contiguity weights (W), evaluated against 499 permutation-based null replicates. Local spatial clusters were identified with LISA (p<0.05), and disease hot spots confirmed with the Kulldorff circular scan statistic (B=99 Monte Carlo permutations, 40% maximum population window).
>
> CVD rates were regressed on poverty, uninsured rate, and PM2.5 using OLS and a spatial lag model (SLM). PM2.5 exposure at the county level was estimated via inverse distance weighting (IDW, p=2) from point-monitor readings. Healthcare access was quantified using the Two-Step Floating Catchment Area (2SFCA) method with a 4.5° catchment and distance-decay power of 2.
>
> A Compound Disadvantage Index (CDI) was constructed by averaging quintile scores across CVD mortality, poverty rate, PM2.5, uninsured rate, and 2SFCA access, identifying counties bearing multiple simultaneous burdens. All analyses used R 4.3+ (`sf`, `spdep`, `spatialreg`, `ggplot2`).

## 9. Final Knowledge Check
1. The scan statistic detects a cluster with p=0.02 but the LISA map shows only 3 HH counties overlapping. How do you reconcile these findings?
2. SLM poverty coefficient is lower than OLS (0.95 vs 1.42). Explain conceptually why spatial adjustment reduces the estimate.
3. CDI identifies 28 counties with "Very High" compound disadvantage. A policy maker wants to intervene in all of them. What information would you add to prioritise among them?
4. The EB smoothing reduces SMR variance by 35%. What are the implications for mapping and for identifying outlier counties?
5. Design a study using ITS analysis (from NB-07 Module 06) to evaluate whether a telemedicine programme in HPSA counties reduced CVD mortality rates over 5 years.

```{r}
cat("CAPSTONE SUMMARY STATISTICS\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")
cat(sprintf("Global Moran's I (CVD rate): %.4f (p=%.4f)\n", I_cvd_val, p_cvd_val))
cat(sprintf("LISA HH clusters: %d | LL: %d counties\n",
            sum(gdf$lisa_cvd == "HH"), sum(gdf$lisa_cvd == "LL")))
cat(sprintf("Scan cluster: LLR=%.2f | p=%.3f | n=%d counties\n",
            sc$best_llr, sc$p, length(sc$best_in)))
cat(sprintf("OLS poverty β=%.3f | SLM poverty β=%.3f | True β=1.20\n", ols_pov, slm_pov))
cat(sprintf("EB smoothing: SMR SD reduced %.4f -> %.4f\n", sd(df$smr), sd(gdf$smr_eb)))
cat(sprintf("  Variance reduction: %.1f%%\n", (1 - sd(gdf$smr_eb) / sd(df$smr)) * 100))
cat(sprintf("Compound Disadvantage Index (Very High): %d counties\n",
            sum(gdf$cdi_cat == "Very High", na.rm = TRUE)))
vhigh_pop <- sum(gdf$population[gdf$cdi_cat == "Very High"], na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("  Population in Very High CDI: %s (%.1f%%)\n",
            format(vhigh_pop, big.mark = ","), vhigh_pop / sum(gdf$population) * 100))
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")
```

## Module 07 Complete

**NB-01** Spatial data & choropleth: data types (point/polygon/raster), sf, quintile/Jenks classification, age-standardised rates, SMR computation, bivariate choropleth, hospital spatial join  
**NB-02** Spatial autocorrelation: queen/rook/distance weights matrices, Global Moran's I with permutation inference, Moran scatterplot, LISA (HH/LL/HL/LH), Getis-Ord G* hot spot analysis, Moran's I on OLS residuals  
**NB-03** Spatial regression & GWR: OLS residual diagnostics, LM lag/error tests, spatial lag model (SLM, ML estimation), spatial error model (SEM), GWR with bandwidth sensitivity, spatially varying coefficient maps  
**NB-04** Disease mapping & Bayesian smoothing: small-area estimation problem, Gamma-Poisson empirical Bayes, BYM/ICAR model structure, Moran eigenvector spatial smoothing, KDE risk surface, brms BYM starter code  
**NB-05** Cluster detection: Kulldorff circular scan statistic, Poisson LLR, Monte Carlo permutation inference, cluster performance evaluation (sensitivity/specificity/PPV), LISA vs scan comparison, secondary cluster detection  
**NB-06** Environmental epidemiology: IDW/kriging exposure interpolation, ecological regression, ecological fallacy, environmental justice (quintile and concentration index), individual vs aggregate effect comparison  
**NB-07** Health service access: PPR, nearest-distance, 2SFCA method, HPSA-style shortage area delineation, access-deprivation correlation, concentration index, Gini coefficient for access distribution  
**NB-08** Capstone: full pipeline → EB smoothing → Moran's I → LISA → scan stat → SLM → 2SFCA → CDI → 8-panel 300 dpi atlas → methods narrative

**Next → Module 08: Reproducible Research & Deployment**
